citations.quote: estimating the price-earnings multiple to use to value Paramount Corporation by looking at the average price-earnings multiple of comparable firms

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Relative valuation prices an equity by applying a market multiple, such as the price-earnings ratio, drawn from comparable firms. Damodaran treats pricing multiples as a fast alternative to intrinsic discounted cash flow valuation.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Relative Valuation Using Pricing Multiples
